example.pinyin: Nà duǒ yún hěn bái, zhēn hǎokàn.
example.gloss: That cloud is very white — it looks really nice.

example.hanzi: 我的鄰居很好，常常幫我。
example.pinyin: Wǒ de línjū hěn hǎo, chángcháng bāng wǒ.
example.gloss: My neighbor is really nice; he often helps me.

example.hanzi: 校長明天要來我們班看看。
example.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng míngtiān yào lái wǒmen bān kànkan.
example.gloss: The principal is coming to our class tomorrow to take a look.

example.hanzi: 我家後面有一個小花園。
example.pinyin: Wǒ jiā hòumiàn yǒu yí ge xiǎo huāyuán.
example.gloss: There's a small garden behind my house.

example.hanzi: 我的耳朵有點痛，要去看醫生。
example.pinyin: Wǒ de ěrduo yǒudiǎn tòng, yào qù kàn yīshēng.
example.gloss: My ear hurts a bit; I need to see a doctor.

example.hanzi: 這個節日我要回家跟爸媽一起吃飯。
example.pinyin: Zhè ge jiérì wǒ yào huí jiā gēn bà mā yìqǐ chīfàn.
example.gloss: This holiday I'm going home to eat with my parents.

grammar.title: Place + 有 + Noun (existence)
grammar.explanation: Use 有 after a place word to say something exists there. The place goes first, then 有, then the thing. To make it negative, use 沒有 (not 不有). Common place words: 家裡、旁邊、後面、天上、學校。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā pángbiān yǒu yí ge huāyuán.
examples.gloss: There's a garden next to my house.
There are a lot of clouds in the sky.

examples.hanzi: 我們學校有一位新校長。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào yǒu yí wèi xīn xiàozhǎng.
examples.gloss: Our school has a new principal.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 小雲，你家後面的花園真好看！
dialogue.pinyin: Xiǎo Yún, nǐ jiā hòumiàn de huāyuán zhēn hǎokàn!
dialogue.gloss: Xiao Yun, the garden behind your house looks great!

dialogue.speaker: 小雲
dialogue.hanzi: 謝謝！那是我跟鄰居一起種的。
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie! Nà shì wǒ gēn línjū yìqǐ zhòng de.
dialogue.gloss: Thanks! My neighbor and I planted it together.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 天氣真好，天上一朵雲都沒有。
dialogue.pinyin: Tiānqì zhēn hǎo, tiānshàng yì duǒ yún dōu méiyǒu.
dialogue.gloss: The weather is great — there isn't a single cloud in the sky.

dialogue.speaker: 小雲
dialogue.hanzi: 對啊，明天是節日，我們學校不用上課。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì a, míngtiān shì jiérì, wǒmen xuéxiào búyòng shàngkè.
dialogue.gloss: Right, tomorrow's a holiday, so we don't have class.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 我知道校長也會來這裡看花。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào xiàozhǎng yě huì lái zhèlǐ kàn huā.
dialogue.gloss: I know the principal is also coming here to look at the flowers.

dialogue.speaker: 小雲
dialogue.hanzi: 真的嗎？那我明天要早一點來花園。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Nà wǒ míngtiān yào zǎo yìdiǎn lái huāyuán.
dialogue.gloss: Really? Then I'll come to the garden a bit earlier tomorrow.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de línjū hěn ài zhòng huā.
Tiānshàng de yún yòu bái yòu duō.
sentences.gloss: The clouds in the sky are white and plentiful.

sentences.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng zài huāyuán lǐ gēn xuéshēng jiǎnghuà.
sentences.gloss: The principal is talking with students in the garden.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de ěrduo yǒudiǎn bù shūfú.
sentences.gloss: My ears feel a bit uncomfortable.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge jiérì wǒmen dōu búyòng shàngbān.
sentences.gloss: This holiday none of us has to work.

example.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi de bízi hěn gāo.
example.gloss: My younger brother's nose is very tall (high-bridged).

vocab.gloss: father's younger brother; uncle; Taiwan pr. [shú shu]

example.pinyin: Wǒ shúshu míngtiān yào lái wǒ jiā.
example.gloss: My uncle is coming to my house tomorrow.

vocab.gloss: to bathe; to take a shower

example.pinyin: Wǒ yào xiān xǐzǎo, zài shuìjiào.
example.gloss: I want to shower first, then go to sleep.

example.hanzi: 你有沒有這個城市的地圖?
example.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu zhège chéngshì de dìtú?
example.gloss: Do you have a map of this city?

example.pinyin: Nǐ de xīn màozi hěn hǎokàn ō!
example.gloss: Your new hat looks really good!

example.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào wǎnshàng hěn ānjìng.
example.gloss: This street is very quiet at night.

grammar.title: 先……再…… (first ... then ...)
grammar.explanation: 先 marks the action done first, and 再 marks the action that follows. Both verbs share the same subject. This pattern is very common in everyday Taiwan Mandarin when talking about the order of daily activities.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān kàn dìtú, zài zǒu ba.
examples.gloss: Let's look at the map first, then go.

examples.pinyin: Tā xiān mǎi màozi, zài qù guàngjiē.
examples.gloss: He'll buy a hat first, then go shopping.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 叔叔,明天我們要去哪裡玩?
dialogue.pinyin: Shúshu, míngtiān wǒmen yào qù nǎlǐ wán?
dialogue.gloss: Uncle, where are we going tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: 叔叔
dialogue.hanzi: 我們去逛那條老街道,好嗎?
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen qù guàng nà tiáo lǎo jiēdào, hǎo ma?
dialogue.gloss: Let's go stroll down that old street, okay?

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 好啊!那我要帶地圖和帽子。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nà wǒ yào dài dìtú hàn màozi.
dialogue.gloss: Sure! Then I'll bring a map and a hat.

dialogue.speaker: 叔叔
dialogue.hanzi: 外面很熱,帽子一定要帶喔。
dialogue.pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn rè, màozi yīdìng yào dài ō.
dialogue.gloss: It's hot outside, you definitely need to bring a hat.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 我先去洗澡,再準備東西。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xiān qù xǐzǎo, zài zhǔnbèi dōngxi.
dialogue.gloss: I'll shower first, then get my things ready.

dialogue.speaker: 叔叔
dialogue.hanzi: 好,早點睡,明天早上八點出發!
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, zǎodiǎn shuì, míngtiān zǎoshàng bā diǎn chūfā!
dialogue.gloss: Okay, sleep early — we leave at eight tomorrow morning!

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shúshu de bízi hěn dà.

sentences.gloss: He takes a shower every night.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào shàng yǒu hěnduō shāngdiàn.
sentences.gloss: There are many shops on this street.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yī zhāng dìtú.
sentences.gloss: I want to buy a map.

example.gloss: I was late for class this morning.

example.pinyin: Xiànzài shì qī diǎn yí kè.
example.gloss: It's a quarter past seven now.

vocab.gloss: to toughen; to temper; to engage in physical exercise

example.hanzi: 我每天早上都去公園鍛鍊身體。
example.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang dōu qù gōngyuán duànliàn shēntǐ.
example.gloss: I go to the park every morning to exercise.

example.pinyin: Zhè tiáo kùzi tài cháng le.

example.hanzi: 夏天很熱，我常常喝冰的。
example.pinyin: Xiàtiān hěn rè, wǒ chángcháng hē bīng de.
example.gloss: Summer is hot; I often drink cold drinks.

example.hanzi: 我們下午在圖書館讀書吧。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ zài túshūguǎn dúshū ba.
example.gloss: Let's study at the library this afternoon.

grammar.title: 用「刻」說時間：…點一刻／…點三刻
grammar.pattern: 時間點 + 一刻 / 三刻
grammar.explanation: 「刻」是十五分鐘。「八點一刻」就是八點十五分，「八點三刻」就是八點四十五分。說時間的時候，「刻」比「分」更口語，常常用在早上、上班或上課的時間上。

examples.hanzi: 現在三點一刻，我們走吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài sān diǎn yí kè, wǒmen zǒu ba.
examples.gloss: It's a quarter past three now, let's go.

examples.hanzi: 我六點一刻起床，去公園鍛鍊。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ liù diǎn yí kè qǐchuáng, qù gōngyuán duànliàn.
examples.gloss: I get up at 6:15 and go to the park to work out.

examples.hanzi: 圖書館九點一刻開門，你別遲到。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn jiǔ diǎn yí kè kāimén, nǐ bié chídào.
examples.gloss: The library opens at 9:15; don't be late.

dialogue.speaker: 小文
dialogue.pinyin: Wéi, nǐ dào túshūguǎn le ma?
dialogue.gloss: Hello, have you got to the library yet?

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 還沒，我剛出門，可能會遲到一點。
dialogue.pinyin: Hái méi, wǒ gāng chūmén, kěnéng huì chídào yìdiǎn.
dialogue.gloss: Not yet, I just left home; I might be a bit late.

dialogue.speaker: 小文
dialogue.hanzi: 現在已經九點一刻了啊！
dialogue.pinyin: Xiànzài yǐjīng jiǔ diǎn yí kè le a!
dialogue.gloss: It's already a quarter past nine!

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 對不起，我先換褲子，十分鐘後就到。
dialogue.pinyin: Duìbùqǐ, wǒ xiān huàn kùzi, shí fēnzhōng hòu jiù dào.
dialogue.gloss: Sorry, I'll change my trousers first and be there in ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: 小文
dialogue.hanzi: 好，我在裡面讀書，夏天外面太熱了。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ zài lǐmiàn dúshū, xiàtiān wàimiàn tài rè le.
dialogue.gloss: OK, I'll read inside; it's too hot outside in summer.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 了解！我先騎腳踏車過去，下午再一起去鍛鍊。
dialogue.pinyin: Liǎojiě! Wǒ xiān qí jiǎotàchē guòqù, xiàwǔ zài yìqǐ qù duànliàn.
dialogue.gloss: Got it! I'll bike over now; this afternoon we can go work out together.

sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài bā diǎn yí kè le.
sentences.gloss: It's a quarter past eight now.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu duànliàn shēntǐ.
Xiàtiān wǒ cháng qù túshūguǎn kànshū.
sentences.gloss: In summer I often go to the library to read.
